reasoning_content:
We need to install Rust, Node, pnpm, just, wasm-pack, bacon, sqlx-cli. Docker available. Let's start installing. Let's check network access first and git status/commit.

Let me plan. Install prerequisites:
- Rust via rustup
- wasm32 target
- Node.js + pnpm
- just
- wasm-pack
- bacon
- sqlx-cli
- Docker images for infra

Then run `just setup`, `just build`. Possibly `just migrate-up` needs infra. The installation guide quick start uses docker compose infra.

Let's begin. Check internet.

action.command: cd /workspace && git log --oneline -1 && git status --short | head; echo "---"; cat .env.example; echo "---"; which curl wget git gcc cc make; curl -sSI https://sh.rustup.rs -o /dev/null -w "rustup:%{http_code}\n" --max-time 15; curl -sSI https://nodejs.org -o /dev/null -w "nodejs:%{http_code}\n" --max-time 15

tool_call.name: terminal
